verdict.rationale: GitHub documents GitHub Actions as a way to automate and execute software development workflows in the repository (github-docs-38), with CI/CD built in (github-docs-11). That is the product's own workflow-execution engine, but nothing in the evidence shows time-based or recurring triggers. Missing for 10: documented schedule/cron triggers for recurring workflow runs, any way to schedule recurring Copilot agent tasks, and independent or hands-on confirmation of scheduled execution.
